There is a scam occurring on Amazon at this moment. It includes both books and items you purchase. The book one centers around books being sold at incredibly low prices by brand new sellers. These people are not looking for your money. They are looking for your information. The scam works by a customer seeing a great sale on a book, they hit the 1-click buy option, if they have it enabled, and then the sale goes through. You won't ever get your book. You can cancel the order and get a refund, but it is already too late, they have your information they wanted for future phishing/social engineering attempts. I found out about this book scam last night. Someone on here posted about it.

Today, I happen to be looking for Zelda Amiibo's for BOTW. I notice there are several new sellers all of a sudden and they are all offering the amiibo's at half the retail cost. Sure enough, they all had the one click buy option, but I have it disabled. I did some more looking and sure enough there are more items being sold at incredibly low prices compared to other third party sellers. This is the same as the book scam. They just want you to see the item, probably on mobile, and click buy. They then get all your information that they are after. You won't get the item. I saw at least 3 duplicates for the Zelda BOTW Archer Amiibo. I can't link it here because they don't let amazon links. Feel free to look it up.
